purpose: Policy registry/master dataset for RAG and ORCA Decision Agents

usage.rag_source: normalized policy records and separately extracted policy criteria
usage.original_policy_sheet: reference/provenance only, not a second active RAG corpus

important_notes: This JSON preserves the supplied policy-master information and does not invent CPT/HCPCS or ICD-10 codes.
Where coding is referenced through an associated CMS Billing & Coding Article, that reference remains a reference rather than fabricated code mappings.
Actual coverage, medical-necessity, documentation, and diagnosis/procedure criteria should be stored as extracted policy content/RAG chunks when available.
LCD applicability should be evaluated using claim location/jurisdiction and contractor information.

policies.policy_title: Positron Emission Tomography (FDG) for Oncologic Conditions
policies.version/revision_date: Version 4
policies.procedure_codes: CPT 78811-78813 (PET only, by body region), 78814-78816 (PET/CT, by body region — 78815 skull base to mid-thigh and 78816 whole body are the most commonly billed); HCPCS A9552 (FDG radiotracer) billed alongside the PET CPT code; modifier PI (initial treatment strategy) or PS (subsequent treatment strategy) required on every claim.
policies.diagnosis_codes: ICD-10-CM: cancer-site-specific codes (e.g., C34.x lung, C50.x breast, C18-C20 colorectal) supporting a biopsy-proven or strongly suspected solid tumor or myeloma diagnosis; List I/List II diagnosis groupings vary by initial vs. subsequent treatment strategy per the NCD coding material; cervical cancer (C53.x) is excluded from initial-staging coverage.
policies.source_document: CMS Medicare Coverage Database + NCD 220.6.17 ICD-10 coding list (verified live, Aug 2026)
